list.description: Your private talent pool. No other organization can browse or search it. Turn on matching for a candidate to see partner jobs that fit.
list.anonymized: Candidate anonymized. Their personal information was removed; referral and finance history is kept.
list.notMatchingHint: Record their permission and turn on matching to find partner jobs for them.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, headline or exact skill
list.emptyFilteredBody: Try a different search or clear the filters.
list.emptyBody: Add someone you represent, or import a CSV. They stay private to your organization until you choose to submit them to a partner job.
list.caption: Candidates, {total} total

new.title: Add candidate
new.description: Only professional details are used for matching. After saving, you'll record the candidate's permission and turn on matching.

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.description: Changes to matching attributes trigger a background re-match.

detail.created: Candidate saved. Next: record their permission, then turn on matching.
detail.updated: Changes saved. Opportunities will refresh in a moment.
detail.matchingOff: Turn on matching to see partner jobs that fit.
detail.noOpportunities: No partner jobs fit yet. We re-check automatically.
detail.noReferrals: Not submitted to any partner job yet.
detail.deleteBody: Anonymize this record if the candidate asks you to delete their data.

form.identityBody: Only your organization sees this. It's never used for matching, and never shared unless you choose to when submitting the candidate.
form.headline: Headline
form.matchingBody: These professional details decide which partner jobs fit. The more you fill in, the better the matches. We never ask for or use protected characteristics.
form.legalBasisHint: Most recruiters use Consent. Confirm with your privacy counsel.
form.privacyNotice: The candidate received our privacy notice
form.notesHint: Only your organization sees these. Never shared with partners.

toast.active_for_matching: Matching is on. New opportunities usually appear within a minute.
toast.unavailable: Marked unavailable. Matching is paused until you turn it back on.

setup.onBody: Partners can't see {name} unless you submit them.
setup.pausedBody: Turn matching back on when they're open to new roles again.
setup.getMatchedBody: Two quick steps. Partners never see your candidate unless you decide to submit them.
setup.stepPermissionHint: Note how they agreed to be represented (e.g. an email or signed intake form).
setup.stepMatchingReady: MissionHub will start looking for partner jobs that fit.

consent.jobSharing: Permission to share for one job
consent.revokeJobSharing: The partner recruiter immediately loses access to the shared profile and documents for this referral. This can't be undone; a new authorization would be needed.
consent.revokeProcessing: Matching stops for this candidate right away. Past records are kept for your audit trail.
consent.basisHint: Most recruiters use Consent. Confirm the right basis with your privacy counsel.
consent.scopeDefault: Store profile and match against partner job openings for recruitment purposes
consent.evidenceHint: e.g. “Confirmed by email on Nov 3” or “Signed intake form”

documents.deleteBody: The file is permanently removed from storage. Copies already shared in referrals follow that referral's authorization.
documents.uploadLabel: Upload resume (PDF or DOCX, max 10 MB)
documents.uploadHint: PDF or DOCX, max 10 MB. Stored privately, never shared automatically.

anonymize.title: Anonymize this candidate?
anonymize.body: Permanently removes name, contact details, notes, experience and documents, and revokes all authorizations. Referral history and financial records remain for audit. This cannot be undone.

import.title: Import candidates
import.description: Upload a CSV, review every row, then confirm. Duplicate checks run only within your organization.
import.columnsHint: Columns: {columns}. Use semicolons inside a cell for lists (e.g. {example}). Only {required} is required.
import.caption: Row validation results
import.skipNote: Rows with errors are skipped. Fix them in the file and import again. Imported candidates start as drafts.

validation.salaryOrder: Maximum must be at least the minimum
validation.invalidOption: Choose one of the listed options
validation.evidence: Describe how and when the authorization was obtained

errors.permissionRequired: Record the candidate's permission before turning on matching.
errors.selectJob: Select the job this authorization covers.
errors.revokeReason: Provide a reason for the revocation.
errors.consentNotFound: Authorization not found or already revoked.
errors.chooseFile: Choose a PDF or DOCX file.
errors.fileType: Only PDF and DOCX files are accepted.
errors.fileSize: Files must be 10 MB or smaller.
errors.scanRejected: This file failed the security scan and can't be opened.
errors.anonymizeReason: Provide a reason (e.g. deletion request reference).
errors.csvSize: CSV files must be 2 MB or smaller.
errors.csvChooseAgain: Choose the CSV file again to confirm.
errors.csvChanged: The file changed since the preview. Preview it again.
errors.csvNothing: No valid, non-duplicate rows to import.
errors.csvTooMany: Import up to {max} rows at a time.
errors.csvDuplicate: Possible duplicate: a candidate with this email already exists in your organization

success.activated: Candidate activated. Matching runs in the background.
success.consentRevoked: Authorization revoked. Any partner access based on it has been removed.
success.uploaded: Uploaded. The file is being scanned and can be shared once it passes.

imported.one: {count} candidate imported as a draft. Review it and record authorization before activating.
imported.other: {count} candidates imported as drafts. Review each and record authorizations before activating.

resume.title: Start from a resume
resume.subtitle: Upload a resume or paste its text. We'll pick up contact details and the skills it mentions — you review everything before saving.
resume.subtitleAi: Upload a resume or paste its text (scanned PDFs too). AI fills in the profile — you review everything before saving.
resume.textPlaceholder: Paste the resume here: experience, skills, education…
resume.fileDrop: Drop a PDF, DOCX or TXT here, or click to choose
resume.fileHint: Up to 10 MB. Scanned PDFs (images) can't be read.
resume.fileHintAi: Up to 10 MB. Scanned PDFs are read by AI.
resume.skip: or fill it in manually below

done.one: {count} field filled. Check it below before saving.
done.other: {count} fields filled. Check them below before saving.

resume.doneAi: Read by AI. Empty fields weren't in the resume.
resume.doneBasic: Basic reading: contact details and skills mentioned. Fill in the rest below.

errors.fileType: Use a PDF, DOCX or TXT file.
errors.fileSize: The file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.noText: We couldn't find readable text. If it's a scanned PDF, paste the text instead.
errors.tooShort: Paste the full resume — at least a few lines.
